# FX Designer

> Browser-based procedural effect-texture designer (WebGL2, TypeScript, Vite, no UI
> framework). Users build node graphs of GPU generators, operators and simulations and export
> textures, maps and flipbooks for games.

Read in this order:

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, conventions and rules for changing the code.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): layers, node graph, rendering pipeline,
  documents, UI.
- [docs/AUTHORING.md](docs/AUTHORING.md): step-by-step recipes for new generators, operators
  and simulations, with a prompt template.
- [docs/NODES.md](docs/NODES.md): generated reference of every node (params as uniforms,
  ranges, inputs, presets). Source of each node: `src/generators/**/<id>.ts` + `.glsl`.

Key facts: a shader generator is `vec4 generate(vec2 uv)` returning grayscale (the Post
Process colorizes it); params become `u_<key>` uniforms; generator ids and param keys are
persisted (rename = migration in `src/app/document.ts`).
